description: OHLC Aggregation history profiles by sample interval. History counts are product configuration (not derived from warm-up). Prefer exact wall-clock periods when the sample interval divides them. When a label cannot divide evenly (e.g. 5m at 9s), use the largest exact sample grid below the nominal period and set nominal_seconds so UI/metadata remain transparent. Add intervals or timeframe entries here without code changes. Each entry needs seconds divisible by the profile interval.
